latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Avito skill, enabling management of your Avito.ru account via API.

- Authenticate with Avito and obtain an access token using your client credentials.
- View basic account information and your user ID.
- Check your account balance.
- List your active advertisements.
- View messenger chats linked to your account.
- Included detailed usage instructions for each feature.
- Outlined planned features such as item creation, editing, and advanced messenger support.
